products.name: iFlytek Spark
products.note: Chinese voice+language AI; speech recognition; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
iFlytek Spark is a Chinese voice and language AI combining speech recognition with large language model capabilities, positioning the company as a supplier of AI infrastructure rather than a consumer-facing model.

iFlytek's focus on speech recognition and translation reflects a different layer of the AI stack than the large text models dominating Western discourse. Speech interfaces require substantial compute for real-time processing, making them dependent on the same power and infrastructure constraints that bind larger language models. The company's emphasis on cross-language capability suggests it is optimizing for markets beyond English, where speech recognition remains a genuine frontier rather than a solved problem.

The data covers iFlytek's product category and stated technical focus, but does not detail the compute resources deployed, the power consumption of Spark, or the infrastructure iFlytek operates to support it. It does not specify whether Spark runs on-device or relies on cloud compute. For understanding whether iFlytek's growth would face the same grid and power constraints as other AI scaling, these specifics matter more than the product's existence.

profile_text.body:
iFlytek is an AI company founded in 1999 and headquartered in Hefei, China. On its own website it describes itself as a world-leading AI solution provider of language exchange and machine learning. The site also notes that iFlytek demonstrated AI translation solutions at the 2025 Boao Entrepreneur Forum, which it frames as advancing global communication.

Its tracked product is iFlytek Spark, listed as a chat and general large language model offering. The record describes it as Chinese voice and language AI with speech recognition, and advises a cross-border data review.

No litigation, MCP server, SEC, or patent facts are held for the company.
